title: Health
description: GET /health. The add-on's own account of itself and of its target. Served even when the target is unreachable.

reachable.description: A real call to the target just succeeded.

product.description: The manifest's product: what people call it.

last_read_at.description: When the add-on last read the target.

credential_scopes.description: The scopes the target credential holds, self-reported and advisory; the kit warns on the kind's denylist.

credential_expiry.description: Which of three states the credential is in.

credential_expires_at.description: When the credential expires; present only when credential_expiry is set.

log_head.description: The mutation log's head digest, never empty: the digest of the empty log until the first record. Each record changes it.

log_records.description: The mutation log's length. It never decreases, across restart, rotation or compaction; while it stays the same, log_head stays the same. Syndra anchors both and flags any other movement as tampering.

target_reads.description: Feature freshness. Every read the add-on has made of its app since it started; never decreases while it runs (it may start again at 0, like an OpenMetrics counter), so a kit can prove a fresh read happened.

snapshot_taken_at.description: When the add-on's mirror of the target was taken.
